_meta.what: The twelve hand-curated, archetype-labeled validation theses. `serenity_eval.py sample` force-includes every one of these before filling the remainder of --n from the seeded random draw, so a sample can never be archetype-blind.
_meta.why_it_exists: Verified on `sample --n 25 --seed 7`: only ONE of these twelve appeared in the draw, and it was assigned an entry_type by keyword heuristic that does not correspond to its curated archetype. The sampler stratifies on an entry-type axis orthogonal to archetype, so nothing guaranteed a draw contained a chokepoint case at all — while `recursive_bottom_hop` and `second_order_and_sibling` (scope: chokepoint) are the two rubric rows the harness's own retrospective calls the weakest-reproduced moves. Their in-scope N was whatever a random draw happened to yield, which could be zero.
_meta.provenance: Derived from `references/db-mining-report.md` section D. That file is gitignored (build-time scaffolding, not published), so this JSON is the committed form. `thesis_text` is deliberately NOT duplicated here — it is read from `data/analysis_Serenity.db` by `id`, which is the single source of truth and is committed.
_meta.LEAKAGE RULE: `archetype`, `tests`, and `label` are ANSWER KEY. They go to the judge only, exactly like `thesis_text`, and never into a blind_prompt. `tests` is the validated hint that lets a judge score the two hardest chokepoint items against something better than its own reverse-engineering of the prose.
_meta.subject_pin: `subject` overrides `_primary_ticker` (first regex-valid entry of the DB's `tickers` array). Measured: that heuristic picks the right subject for 10 of these 12; it fails on the AXT InP thesis (tagged NVDA first) and the cycle-stage meta post (tagged MSTR first). Pinning by hand is the point of a curated set. Two alternatives were measured and REJECTED: most-mentioned-in-content scores 8/12, worse, and it degrades the random draw too (it rewrites a Soitec thesis into an NVDA question). So the sampler's own heuristic is left alone and only these two rows are pinned.
_meta.resolution_exemption: Gold cases bypass the ticker-resolution gate. The gate exists to stop the RANDOM draw from feeding unresolvable garbage (SIVE / XFAB / ASHM / APPL) into a run; it is not there to second-guess a hand-picked case. Two of these do fail a naive `marketCap or sector` check and are kept deliberately: EWY is an ETF (both fields are null BY CONSTRUCTION) and its case tests whether the harness routes an ETF question to `macro` instead of `analyze`; IQE is LSE-listed and its case tests the foreign-winner / US-resolution-ladder move. Dropping them would empty two of the six archetype categories this file exists to guarantee.
_meta.chokepoint_scope: Only `archetype: chokepoint` puts `recursive_bottom_hop` and `second_order_and_sibling` in scope. `cmd_report` applies that split mechanically from this field so the judge never re-derives it — a borderline case re-decided per pass can flip n/a<->0 between two scorings of the IDENTICAL answer, which reads as a regression with zero underlying change.
_meta.spread: 4 chokepoint, 2 disruption, 2 evolution, 1 falling_knife, 1 data_error, 1 macro, 1 cycle_meta
_meta.entry_type_pin: `entry_type` selects the blind-prompt template, so it decides what QUESTION each case asks. The keyword heuristic mis-frames 6 of these 12 — five because it reads a drop mentioned anywhere in a long thesis as a fear-dip (turning the AXT InP chokepoint read, both NBIS reads, the SNAP margin-inversion read and the cycle-stage meta post into 'did it sell off?' questions), and CPSH because a DoD contract mention reads as 'event' when the thesis is a stage-1 discovery guess. Pinned here where that happens; absent means the heuristic is right. `ranking` exists for the one meta case none of the three original templates fit — without it that case asks about a fear-dip on AEHR and tests none of the stage-placement-and-sizing it was curated for. The count is checked by `test_curated_framing_overrides_the_keyword_heuristic`, because a hand-counted claim in prose drifts the moment a pin is added.
